items.source: Create a new DispatcherHandler which needs to be configured with an ApplicationContext through setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 创建一个新的DispatcherHandler，需要通过setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)使用一个ApplicationContext对其进行配置。

items.source: Create a new DispatcherHandler for the given ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 为给定的ApplicationContext创建一个新的DispatcherHandler。

items.source: DispatcherHandler is also designed to be a Spring bean itself and implements ApplicationContextAware for access to the context it runs in. If DispatcherHandler is declared as a bean with the name "webHandler", it is discovered by WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext) which puts together a processing chain together with WebFilter, WebExceptionHandler and others.
items.translation: `DispatcherHandler` 本身也被设计为 Spring Bean，并实现了ApplicationContextAware接口以访问其运行所在的上下文。如果将 `DispatcherHandler` 声明为名为 "webHandler" 的 Bean，它将被WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext)发现，该构建器会将其与 `WebFilter`、`WebExceptionHandler` 及其他组件组合成处理链。

items.source: Note: This method may return null if invoked prior to setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 注意： 如果在调用setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)之前调用此方法，它可能会返回null。
